items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR despite indefinite sideline for superficial blood clot in calf; first game without him. Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; information gathering continues.
items.implication: McKee starts with healthy top-4 pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for PHI WRs/TE; McKee streaming upside in favorable spot.

items.text: AJ Brown (ankle) listed QUESTIONABLE; unclear status. Practiced limited all week earlier than expected. Berry notes possible return.
items.implication: Game-time; if IN, immediate WR1 usage. If OUT, NE WR downgrade.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if cleared; monitor Saturday.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle/high-ankle sprain) QUESTIONABLE and unclear. Diagnosed high-ankle but practiced; may be more about next Thursday availability.
items.why: High-ankle sprain; surprised he practiced; NE has TNF next.
items.implication: Risky start; Rhamondre volume secure if limited/out. Patriots tried out RBs.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs. Panthers; second straight miss. Will Shipley also OUT.
items.implication: Dameon Pierce expected to lead backfield in thin PHI RB room behind McKee.
items.opportunity: Lead RB carries/goal-line for Pierce; elevated pass-catcher volume possible.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at Cleveland; another game without him. Tyler Huntley starts.
items.why: Ankle; no practice progress to clearance.
items.implication: Downgrade to BAL pass game; Flowers still WR2-range, Andrews benchable.

items.text: Caleb Williams QUESTIONABLE but seems more probable after full practices. Officially Q.
items.why: Hamstring; full practice then Q tag.
items.implication: Likely plays; Bears pass game upgrade vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for CHI pass-catchers if active.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition as QUESTIONABLE; injury occurred in individual drills.
items.why: Groin; Friday add after visible issue in drills.
items.implication: Monitor closely; IND TE downgrade risk.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other IND pass-catchers (Pittman/Downs/Pierce) up.

items.text: PHI: McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce. PIT: thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek); expect heavy 2-WR with Metcalf + Bernard. Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle/Caleb more probable than pure Q.
items.why: Healthy weapons for McKee; PIT personnel force Metcalf-centric sets; practice trends on Qs.
items.implication: Start PHI pass-catchers confidently; Metcalf heavy usage; lean start on listed probables.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets concentrated; Metcalf snap share spike in 2-WR.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell for Jets.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) for Chiefs along with Tyquan Thornton.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for remaining KC pass-catchers.

items.text: IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey & Quentin Johnston (no designation), DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.why: Removed from report or full/no designation.
items.implication: Full expected roles; Smith boosts McKee's weapons.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation remains open.
items.why: Commissioner action; probe ongoing but status change.
items.implication: ROS RB1 return imminent post-W6; stash/hold.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) vs. Rams.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shift; other backs elevated.
